name: ColorBends-TS-TW
title: Color Bends
blurb: Flowing color bands warping and morphing across the canvas.
description: THREE.js shader component rendering flowing bands of color with customizable warp, frequency, and noise. Responds to pointer movement with smooth parallax. Supports transparent or solid backgrounds and up to 8 custom colors.
use_when: Full-page or section backgrounds where flowing, organic motion creates visual interest without feeling chaotic.
avoid_when: Low-end devices or when a static background is preferred; uses continuous RAF animation with shader-based rendering.
a11y: WebGL canvas with pointer responsiveness. No keyboard navigation or semantic content. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
